description: Get one batch: its `state` (`running`, `on_hold`, `finished` or `cancelled`), why it waits (`onHold.reason`), the addresses it skipped and why, and `counts` of its checks by where they are and by verdict. `counts.uncertain` and `counts.noAnswer` are checks that got no answer: retry_email_check_run sends them again.
name: get_email_check_run
title: Get a batch of checks
